title: Founded November 1871 in Sioux City
summary: Sioux City Foundry Co. began at Main and Seventh. More than 150 years later the family-owned shop still pours, cuts, and ships from Iowa and Nebraska plants.

detail.lead: Sioux City Foundry Co. started in November 1871 on the corner of Main and Seventh streets in Sioux City, Iowa.
body: From that corner shop the company grew into a family-owned One-Stop Metal Shop with Plant 1 in Sioux City, Iowa, and Plant 2 in South Sioux City, Nebraska.

Today the live divisions include warehouse steel, rebar, contract manufacturing, and iron castings. This sample article is a historical note for the Abrinsky/SCF redesign, not an official press release.
highlights: Two-plant footprint in Iowa and Nebraska
